content: Amid a demand by the Opposition Bharatiya Janata Party and the Janata Dal (Secular) for announcement of farm loan waiver by the Karnataka government, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said that the State was willing to share the financial burden of loan waiver if the Union government makes such an announcement

The image turned the awkward moment into a joke about Muse's supposed ability to bring even AI rivals together.

content: A fresh spell of rain is expected to affect several parts of India on Friday, with the India Meteorological Department (IMD) warning of heavy to very heavy showers in multiple states.

content: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has pressed to accelerate overland trade as the blockade limits the vast majority of imports while cutting off the oil and gas sales that largely keep the economy alive.

content: If our answer to unsafe streets is to ask women to stop using them, we haven't solved the safety problem.

content: Ravindra Singh Bhati has been something of a social media phenomenon. He has 3.1 million followers on Instagram, over 1.6 million on Facebook and his twitter handle has 3.49 lakh followers.

content: "It is reiterated that no eligible elector will be left behind," the Goa Chief Electoral Officer said.

title: Take Schemes To Grassroots: Key Takeaways From Union ministers' Brainstorming Session
content: Ministers were instructed to remain active at the grassroots level and ensure that the benefits of the government's welfare schemes reach everyone. They were also asked to share what they had learned from their colleagues, with these insights being documented.

title: China To Send 2 Giant Pandas, Ping Ping And Fu Shuang, To US Zoo
content: Two giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will arrive at Zoo Atlanta "in a few days," Xi announced at the start of his state visit to the United States on Thursday.

title: Child Rape Cases Went Up 4 Times Over A Decade, Convictions Remained Low
content: In 2015, police recorded 10,934 girl victims below the age of 18. By 2024, that figure had jumped to 43,675.

title: Centre Seeks 2-Year Window To Implement Top Court's OBC Creamy Layer Verdict
content: The government has sought a "limited prospective overruling" of the judgment, saying its immediate application to earlier and ongoing recruitment can unsettle seniority, cadre allocation and appointments of candidates who were not parties to the litigation.

title: Straitcraft: How geography gives Iran leverage and could do the same for India
content: Since the onset of the US-Iran war over 200 days ago, Iran has been strategically utilizing maritime chokepoints such as Hormuz. This has resulted in a marked decline in oil flows, affecting the global economy and forcing the US to reconsider its stance. Concurrently, India is exploring ways to capitalize on its geographical advantages against China.

title: Rahul attacks Centre over EC-SIR row; BJP calls it 'jooth ki goonj'
content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has intensified accusations against the government and the Election Commission regarding electoral integrity. He demands the immediate resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing evidence of electoral manipulation. Concerns regarding unresolved objections from Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi further bolster his claims. The BJP has responded by rejecting his allegations and challenging his assertions about anti-incumbency.

title: Xi Jinping tests Donald Trump with 'Thucydides Trap'
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping asserted that the US and China should work together to avoid conflict. He emphasized that China's rise does not have to threaten the United States' position. Despite past confrontational rhetoric, President Trump responded positively, highlighting their relationship. Critics remain skeptical, arguing that China's military expansion poses significant risks. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the importance of engaging with China amidst these challenges.

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific Ocean conservation
content: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Wife sold shares, bought husband’s Rs 7.5 crore property; taxman send notice
content: When a woman sold her unlisted shares, she reported long-term capital gains of Rs 8.31 crore. In June 2021, she put Rs 6.91 crore into a residential property on Juhu Tara Road, Mumbai, and claimed exemption under Section 54F.

title: 'No eligible elector will be left behind': Goa CEO clarifies on 97 missing voters
content: The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa has provided clarity regarding the exclusion of 97 voters from the electoral rolls. These individuals were initially identified due to discrepancies reported during the Special Intensive Revision process. However, follow-up house visits successfully registered many eligible voters. This incident has raised concerns over the reliability of the Election Commission's ECINet software, prompting criticism from opposition parties about electoral registration procedures and centralization.

title: Eco moorings cut seagrass damage by 94% at England’s Studland Bay
content: At England’s Studland Bay, eco-moorings helped seagrass recover after years of damage from traditional boat anchors. A study found bare patches in one trial area shrank by 94% between 2021 and 2025. Volunteer divers have also reported rising seahorse numbers, along with sightings of eels, crabs and other marine life.

title: Mississippi sand used to build 7 islands, restoring over 270 acres of habitat
content: Engineers have successfully finalized a habitat restoration initiative at McGregor Lake, utilizing sand from the Mississippi River. This ambitious project involved the construction of seven islands, the enhancement of floodplain forests, and the protection of vital wetlands. The undertaking, spanning six years, has revitalized over 270 acres of aquatic habitats, significantly benefiting local wildlife and fostering greater biodiversity, all while striving to harmonize navigation and ecological preservation.

title: Nokia closes China research hub; recalls CEO’s Huawei warning to Europe
content: Nokia is shutting its Hangzhou radio R&D centre in China by end-2026, cutting around 1,600 jobs, after its Greater China revenue fell over 58% since 2018. The closure revives CEO Justin Hotard's pointed question to Europe: why does Huawei still run nearly 60% of Germany's 5G sites while Nokia holds under 3% share in China? Restructuring charges have tripled to €800 million, even as AI and cloud orders surge 105%.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M affordable housing project offers $322 senior homes
content: After his NBA career, Alonzo Mourning founded AM Affordable Housing to address the pressing need for affordable homes in South Florida. Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. With overwhelming demand and countless applicants vying for limited options, Mourning draws on his foster care history to fuel his philanthropic mission.

title: Tom Brady reflects on difficult childhood and his children’s privileged lifestyle
content: Tom Brady, the New England Patriots’ legend, opens up about how his parents worked hard for him to make it in life.

title: Russell Wilson and Ciara’s $3M hospital donation and $1.75M school gift
content: Russell Wilson and Ciara have spent more than a decade using their Why Not You Foundation to support children through education, health care and hunger programs. Their work includes a $1.75 million school investment, a $3 million hospital gift, a $2 million donation in Mexico and $500,000 for Atlanta food programs, along with wider fundraising and youth programs.

title: Did AI-‘kill chain’ lead to deadly Iran school strike? What report claims
content: A devastating missile strike by the US on a school in Minab, Iran, has led to the tragic loss of over 150 lives, including 123 innocent children. Investigations uncovered serious issues in the military’s targeting tactics, pointing to outdated intelligence and a lack of comprehensive civilian harm evaluations. The AI-powered Maven Smart System was crucial in target assessments.

title: Horse declared ‘unfit’ by EFI gets all-clear from Asian Games organisers
content: Chheda’s 19-year-old horse, Dono Di Maggio, cleared the mandatory veterinary inspection ahead of Friday’s dressage competition, directly clearing the way for the rider to compete.

title: SC flags ‘false’ POCSO cases in marital disputes, bars immediate arrest of accused parent
content: The Supreme Court has stressed the need for cautious evaluations prior to immediate arrests under the POCSO Act. They underscored the crucial role of expert child assessments when parents are under scrutiny. In matrimonial conflicts, police are urged to confirm relationships before making arrests. The court expressed concern over the rising incidents of false allegations in family disputes, highlighting the importance of in-depth investigations prioritizing children's welfare.

title: Chess Olympiad: India miss chance to close in as Gukesh draws; Savitha saves women’s day
content: Gukesh pushed hard but was held to a draw by Azerbaijan’s Mahammad Muradli as India missed a chance to close the gap on the Chess Olympiad leaders. Uzbekistan and Germany lead the open section with 14 points. In the women’s event, Savitha Shri extended her winning streak to seven, rescuing India against Kazakhstan and keeping their title hopes alive.

title: Tata Sons tells Noel Tata Chandrasekaran reappointment was legally valid: Report
content: Tata Sons has asserted the legal validity of N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as chairman. The company cited legal opinions supporting the decision against the Tata Trusts' allegations of governance breaches. A pending vote on his directorship is crucial for his continuation in the role. Complications arise as regulatory restrictions limit the Sir Ratan Tata Trust's voting decisions.

title: Father's 'affairs', property fear: Why Kanpur millionaire's son ordered the hit job
content: Subrat Manocha has been arrested for allegedly plotting the murder of his father, Vineet Manocha, over financial concerns. The father was killed in his apartment in Kanpur, and investigations led to multiple arrests, including his daughter-in-law Shalu. Police have found evidence indicating Subrat's gambling debts and motive linked to his father's relationships. Initial plans to disguise the murder as accidental were abandoned as the plot unfolded.

title: Dubai-based Indian cancelled 2 flats, builder claims deductions; what MahaREAT ruled
content: On July 1, 2026, the homebuyer won the matter before the MahaREAT. In its ruling, the tribunal directed the builder to refund the homebuyer Rs 48.73 lakh and Rs 66.56 lakh, along with interest at the State Bank of India's Marginal Cost of Lending Rate (MCLR) plus 2%.

title: Coach who delivered RCB's first title now appointed MI head coach
content: Keightley had been appointed Mumbai Indians head coach in September 2025. The franchise confirmed her departure in a statement on Thursday.

title: IIT-B student suicide: Sahil Wakode’s parents begin hunger strike in Mumbai
content: Parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, have started a hunger strike. They demand justice and action against those who allegedly tormented their son. The police have opened an investigation into his death, including examination of CCTV footage from the exam hall. Sahil faced allegations of caste discrimination during his studies at IIT Bombay.

title: Akhilesh alleges ‘vote theft’ in 2022 UP polls, says SP will contest 2027 in alliance
content: Akhilesh Yadav addressed a public meeting in Raebareli, alleging the Election Commission assisted in vote theft during 2022. He stated that the Samajwadi Party would have formed the government without these irregularities. Yadav emphasized the importance of an alliance for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections based on winnability. He criticized the BJP for communal politics and promised various reforms if elected.

title: K'taka says ‘will release Cauvery water only if available’; TN flags 20 TMC deficit
content: Karnataka chief minister DK Shivakumar stated that water release depends on availability amid halted reservoir inflows. Tamil Nadu has requested its share of Cauvery water due to crop losses triggered by water shortages. The Supreme Court is reviewing Tamil Nadu's plea against Karnataka's claims of drought conditions. Karnataka previously released water despite facing harsh drought conditions and challenges in reservoir levels.

title: Vithya Ramaraj turns on the afterburners; India storm to 4x400m silver at Asian Games
content: Manu kept India in the race before handing over to Vithya Ramaraj for the final leg. Vithya, known for her strong anchor legs, made up ground on the final lap and pulled India into second place to seal the silver.

title: Mushtaq Khan, 'Welcome' and 'Gadar: Ek Prem Katha' actor, passes away at the age of 56
content: Mushtaq Khan, a celebrated Bollywood actor, sadly passed away on September 24 at Mumbai's Nanavati Hospital after a prolonged battle with cancer that began five years ago. His impressive legacy includes memorable performances in the 'Gadar' franchise and various television shows. Survived by his beloved wife and children, Khan leaves behind a rich artistic heritage that will be cherished by fans and colleagues alike.

title: 87-year-old’s eviction in Madrid sparks protests as Spain's housing crisis deepens
content: Maricarmen, an 87-year-old woman, faced eviction from her Madrid home after a significant rent increase. Her eviction sparked nationwide protests against rising housing costs and limited affordable options. The incident has intensified political debates just before the upcoming general election in Spain. Spain's government has proposed legislation to prevent similar evictions, but challenges remain due to a lack of parliamentary majority.

title: Asian Games: Seema, mixed relay win athletics medals; Roshibina bags Wushu silver
content: India enjoyed a strong medal-winning day at the Asian Games 2026, with Seema winning bronze in the women’s 10,000m and the mixed 4x400m relay team claiming silver. Seema’s medal was India’s first athletics medal at the Games and the country’s first women’s 10,000m medal since 2010. Roshibina Devi added another silver in the women’s 60kg sanda event, securing her second successive Asian Games silver and third overall medal at the continental showpiece.

title: From 33 to 12 hours, 14 to 6: Vande Bharat, roads cutting travel time drastically
content: Across bridges, tunnels, expressways and railways, projects are replacing long detours, difficult terrain and slower routes with more direct connections.

title: 'No anti-incumbency against BJP?' Party counters Rahul with TN, Bengal poll history
content: BJP leader's claim that anti-incumbency has "disappeared" for the BJP . BJP national spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi cited the Congress's electoral record in states including Tamil Nadu, west Bengal, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and Odisha to hit back at leader of opposition .

title: ‘US and China should coexist in peace’: Xi meets Trump at White House
content: Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, arrived in a black SUV, the equivalent of the US presidential “Beast” . the two leaders spoke about their “friendship” and ties . he described his relationship with the Chinese leader as a “truly great friendship” built on “mutual respect and the interests of our peoples”

title: Nato boosts intelligence-sharing as Russia-linked sabotage fears grow in Europe
content: sabotage and other incidents linked to Russia put Nato on alert . the alliance remains prepared to deal with potential threats from Moscow, its commander says . comments came after the defence intelligence service warned that Russia was likely to intensify its hybrid warfare campaign against Western countries .

title: India’s homegrown AI-powered combat aircraft hits 100-hour flight test milestone
content: Kaal Bhairava Lite is an indigenous, AI-powered autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for long-endurance intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance (ISR) and tactical operations . Designed and manufactured entirely in India, with an indigenisation rate of 80%, the platform has undergone flight testing in demanding weather conditions . it has also completed a demonstration in the challenging operating environment of J&K, supporting the platform's development .

title: ‘Let Gaza live’: Netanyahu faces protests in New York as demonstrators block roads ahead of UN speech
content: protesters chant slogans such as "Let Gaza live" and "the whole world is watching" the protests come amid rising political controversy over Netanyahu's visit to the u.n. . a kite bearing the words "Free Palestine" was also flown during the protest .

title: Get details, communicate govt’s position effectively, PM Modi tells ministers
content: toi learnt that the PM has advised ministers to put across govt’s views during their engagement with people and media in their constituencies . the suggestion came during the two-day Chintan Shivir at a time when issues around Election Commission’s SIR exercise and the IIT-Bombay controversy have become political flashpoints .

title: Simone Biles’ temporary Texas home lists for $1.2 million after mansion build
content: the four-bedroom property in spring, Texas, is now listed for $1.2 million . the contemporary home covers 3,998 square feet and sits on more than an acre in the gated Benders Landing community . it served as their base while a much larger custom residence was being built .

title: Wangchuk fears 'encounter' after accusing govt of Ladakh atrocities
content: sonam Wangchuk said he feared he could be subjected to an 'encounter' for speaking out against what he called atrocities in ladakh . he said a year after police firing killed four protesters in leh .
